name: 20015 · Washington, DC
findings: ZIP 20015 (Washington) has 203 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 78 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20015 (Washington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20015 (Washington) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
